Mountain Pacific Investment Advisers Has Upped Its Pentair LTD (PNR) Position by $415,450; Market Value Declined; As Bank Montreal Que (BMO) Market Value Declined, Amf Pensionsforsakring Ab Has Raised Its Stake by $2.60 Million 
April 19, 2018 - By Henry Gaston 
Amf Pensionsforsakring Ab increased its stake in Bank Montreal Que (BMO) by 4.49% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Amf Pensionsforsakring Ab bought 32,502 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.54% with the market. The institutional investor held 756,648 shares of the commercial banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $60.75M, up from 724,146 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Amf Pensionsforsakring Ab who had been investing in Bank Montreal Que for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $46.38 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.20% or $0.15 during the last trading session, reaching $75.05. About 256,005 shares traded. Bank of Montreal (NYSE:BMO) has risen 0.84% since April 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.71% the S&P500. 
Mountain Pacific Investment Advisers Inc increased its stake in Pentair Ltd (PNR) by 2.28% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Mountain Pacific Investment Advisers Inc bought 5,935 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.08% with the market. The institutional investor held 266,022 shares of the industrial machinery and components company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $18.79M, up from 260,087 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Mountain Pacific Investment Advisers Inc who had been investing in Pentair Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $12.68B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.09% or $0.79 during the last trading session, reaching $71.11. About 2.11M shares traded or 86.86% up from the average. Pentair plc (NYSE:PNR) has risen 11.82% since April 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 0.27% the S&P500. 
Amf Pensionsforsakring Ab, which manages about $10.21B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in V F Corp (NYSE:VFC) by 49,715 shares to 76,048 shares, valued at $5.63 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 4,738 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 102,816 shares, and cut its stake in Union Pac Corp (NYSE:UNP). 
Among 13 analysts covering Bank Of Montreal ( NYSE:BMO ), 4 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 9 Hold. Therefore 31% are positive. RBC Capital Markets maintained it with “Sector Perform” rating and $84 target in Friday, September 11 report. The stock has “Buy” rating by TD Securities on Wednesday, December 2. The rating was upgraded by Citigroup on Thursday, May 18 to “Buy”. 
Mountain Pacific Investment Advisers Inc, which manages about $946.15M and $950.62M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in General Electric Company (NYSE:GE) by 25,766 shares to 57,991 shares, valued at $1.01 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing.
